description: The golf bag UK golfers would build together: in each of eight slots (driver, fairway wood, hybrid, irons, wedge, putter, ball, bag) the model golfers have picked most on GolfPrice AI, with the share of golfers who picked it and today’s lowest UK price, plus the total. Use for questions like "what driver do most golfers use?", "most popular golf clubs UK" or "what’s in the average golfer’s bag?". Popularity among GolfPrice AI visitors who took part, not a sales chart.
name: peoples_golf_bag
title: The People’s Bag: the golf bag UK golfers would build
